name: Future SHAP domain-level explanation
purpose: Convert existing feature-level Random Forest SHAP values into doctor-friendly domain-level explanations.

domain_aggregation.net_contribution: sum of signed SHAP values inside each domain
domain_aggregation.absolute_influence: sum of absolute SHAP values inside each domain
domain_aggregation.positive_component: sum of positive SHAP values inside each domain
domain_aggregation.negative_component: sum of negative SHAP values inside each domain

interpretation: Positive domain net SHAP pushes the Random Forest prediction above its SHAP baseline; negative domain net SHAP pushes it below the baseline. These values describe model behaviour and do not establish causality. The 25 one-hot encoded district indicators are grouped under District & Geographic Context and must not be interpreted as modifiable causal risk factors.
backend_month_selection_note: Doctor-selected month should be treated as the H1 target month. Backend derives common origin = selected month - 1 month, then returns H1=origin+1, H3=origin+3 and H6=origin+6. Step 28B itself does not change forecast dates.
